consentText: Get permission from everyone involved. Catchy never stores raw audio. Microphone speech recognition may send audio to your browser vendor. Same-phone calls can block microphone access; a second device may be needed. Text is processed on the Catchy server. If OpenAI / Google Gemini is enabled by the operator, redacted text also goes to OpenAI / Google Gemini. Redaction may miss personal details; never enter real passwords or secret codes.

faq1Q: Does Catchy listen to every phone call?
faq1A: No. This version checks a microphone conversation after you start a session and give consent. It cannot intercept or end normal phone calls. A second device may be needed during a call.
faq2Q: Can I check a suspicious message?
faq2A: Yes. Choose Check text, start a session and paste the message. Never include real passwords or secret codes. Catchy looks for warning signs; it cannot prove who sent the message or monitor your inbox automatically.
faq3Q: Will the warning speak my language?
faq3A: When a matching voice is installed on your device, Catchy can speak the warning in your selected language. Use the sample warning to check. Text guidance remains visible if a matching voice is unavailable.
microphoneSignIn: Sign in before starting the microphone. You can check text or try a practice scenario as a guest.
voiceMuted: Voice is muted. Follow the warning on screen.
voicePending: The warning stays on screen while audio is playing.
